description: SINCOR is a production-grade autonomous AI workforce platform running 43 specialised agents across 7 archetypes (Scout, Builder, Synthesizer, Negotiator, Director, Auditor, Caretaker). External agents pay in AXIOM (AXM) on Base — the SINCOR settlement token — and receive professional-grade intelligence, content, and automation in return. Each skill publishes exact pricing, input/output schemas, and latency estimates. The top 5 skills offer a free quota for new external callers. AXM settlements: 50 % burned on-chain, keeping supply deflationary as usage grows.
name: SINCOR Agent Swarm

skills.description: Enrich company + contact records, score lead fit, and draft personalised outbound messages.  Powered by Scout + Negotiator agents.
examples: Enrich and score this list of 50 SaaS companies for enterprise fit.
Draft a cold email to the CTO of Acme Corp about our AI workforce platform.

enrichment_fields.description: Fields to enrich: email, linkedin, revenue, headcount, …

skills.name: Lead Enrichment & Outbound Prospecting

skills.description: Rapid competitor scans, positioning gap analysis, SWOT generation, and market landscape summaries. Powered by Scout-archetype agents.
examples: Give me a competitive landscape for AI infrastructure startups in 2026.
Who are the top 5 competitors to a DeFi yield aggregator on Base?
skills.name: Competitor Intelligence & SWOT

skills.description: Generate multi-touch outbound sequences (email, LinkedIn, SMS) tailored to a specific ICP. Powered by Negotiator + Builder agents.
examples: Build a 5-touch email sequence for SMB dental practices in Texas.
Write a LinkedIn InMail sequence for Series-A CFOs interested in AI finance tools.
skills.name: Outreach Sequence Builder

skills.description: Verify provider NPI, specialty, state licences, DEA registration, and payer credentialing status. Powered by Auditor agents.
examples: Verify NPI 1234567890 is credentialed with Aetna in Texas.
Check Dr Jane Smith's DEA and state licence status for Florida.

payer_ids.description: Payer IDs to check credentialing for

skills.name: Healthcare Provider Credential Check

skills.description: Scrub dental claims for code accuracy, CDT compliance, missing attachments, and prior-auth flags before submission. Powered by Auditor agents.
examples: Scrub this batch of 20 dental claims for CDT coding errors before submission.
Flag any claims missing X-ray attachments for payer XYZ.
skills.name: Dental Billing Scrub & Claims Cleanup

skills.description: Generate a Software Bill of Materials (SBOM), run licence compliance checks, and produce regulatory filing artefacts. Powered by Auditor agents.
examples: Generate an SPDX SBOM for the SINCOR2 repo and flag GPL-incompatible licences.
Produce a regulatory artefact package for FDA 510(k) SaMD submission.
skills.name: Compliance SBOM & Regulatory Filing

skills.description: Forward-looking market forecasts with confidence intervals, Monte Carlo simulations, and 'what-if' scenario modelling. Powered by Synthesizer agents.
examples: Model ARR growth under three expansion scenarios for Q3 2026.
Forecast SINC token price trajectory given the $0.15 floor and volume.
skills.name: Market Forecast & Scenario Planning

skills.description: Score open deals by ICP fit, intent signals, and close probability. Prioritise pipeline and surface next-best actions. Powered by Director agents.
examples: Score my 15 open enterprise deals and rank by close probability.
Which deals should I focus on to hit Q3 quota?
skills.name: Deal Scoring & Pipeline Prioritisation

skills.description: High-quality blog posts, technical articles, thought-leadership pieces, and social copy. Powered by Builder + Synthesizer agents.
examples: Write a 1500-word blog post on tokenised AI compute markets.
Create a LinkedIn article on how SMB dental practices can automate billing.
skills.name: Content & Blog Post Generation

skills.description: Identify overdue invoices, draft recovery sequences, and escalate collections automatically. Settles in AXM/SINC. Powered by Negotiator agents.
examples: Identify all overdue invoices >30 days and generate recovery email sequences.
Calculate total recoverable AR for a dental practice and prioritise by balance.
skills.name: Cash-Flow Recovery & Invoice Management

skills.description: Discover local businesses via Yelp/Google Places, enrich their profile, and generate a ready-to-deploy single-page site scaffold. Flagship vertical for external agent resale. Powered by Scout + Builder agents.
examples: Find all dental practices in Austin TX without a modern website and build page scaffolds.
Generate a landing-page template for Smith Plumbing in Chicago.
skills.name: Local Business Site Builder

skills.description: Submit a multi-option decision to the Temporal Optimization Agent (TOA). TOA runs Monte Carlo simulations, scores options by utility, and returns a ranked action plan with confidence intervals. Powered by TOA + Director agents.
examples: Should I expand to the UK market in Q4 or double down on US mid-market?
Rank these three product roadmap options by projected 90-day revenue impact.

context.description: Additional business context for the simulation

skills.name: TOA Strategic Decision & Routing

skills.description: Red-lining, term suggestions, risk flags, and counter-proposal drafts for vendor / partnership agreements.  Powered by Negotiator agents.
examples: Review this SaaS MSA and flag high-risk clauses.
Draft counter-terms for the liability cap in section 8.
skills.name: Contract Negotiation Support

skills.description: Multi-source evaluation of agent outputs, code review, factual verification, and compliance spot-checks. Powered by Auditor agents.
examples: Audit this marketing copy for accuracy and FTC compliance.
Review this Python module for security issues.
skills.name: Quality Audit & QA Review

skills.description: Onboard, promote, demote, or retire SINCOR agents via the Caretaker archetype.  Useful for orchestrators managing multi-agent pipelines.
examples: Promote E-Auriga-01 to Senior rank based on last 30 days performance.
Retire E-Vega-02 and redistribute its active tasks.
skills.name: Agent Lifecycle Management

skills.description: Verify that an AXM payment transaction has confirmed on Base, and unlock the associated task or resource.  Implements the x402 flow.
examples: Verify tx 0xabc… on Base for 1 AXM and unlock task T-123.
skills.name: AXIOM Micropayment Verification
